Hi all —

Checked our network logs for the invite URL: we see 403s coming back from Zip's CDN when the token parameter is older than 20 hours, which matches Ella's screenshot. That suggests the initial invite likely expired. I just reissued an invite from our Zip console and set a 72-hour validity window. The resend email should be from "no-reply@zipprocure.com" with subject line starting "You're invited to join Redwood Inference on Zip".

If you still see a 403: send me the exact invite URL (please paste the full link) and I will trace it. I also temporarily white-listed zipprocure.com on our outbound proxy while the vendor completes onboarding.

—Dev
